title: The bird, not here
logline: The seawall, the piling, the sill, the bench: four places the bird sits, drawn in four corners of one page, all empty. The one page in the private work that admits it looked. Unsequenced on purpose.

panels.composition: One page divided into four quiet views with no borders: a seawall, a dock piling, a garage sill with jars, a bench, each empty, each without the bird.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, one page holding four quiet views without borders, a seawall, a dock piling, a garage window sill with jars and a bench, each empty, no bird, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
